acceptance: packages.<system>.zmx is the wrapper; overlays.default maps zmx to it; the devshell exposes the wrapper, zp-compatible zmx and the elisp path; README states both install routes (overlay, or explicit zmux-style call), the escape hatches (absolute raw path, ZMX_RAW=1, ZMX_LAUNCHER), and which parts only work on a host with a user systemd.
body: The overlay is the delivery mechanism d-install chose, so it belongs in this repo's outputs rather than in the config repo. Keep the config-side integration (home-manager, keybinds, umbriel, notify-send) out: that lives in flakes, and zmux must stay integration-blind (d-surfaces).
title: Wire the kit into the flake and document install
